terms.text: These sprites are also free for use as long as the spriter or the project itself is credited.

terms.text: For the sake of transparency, these sprites are free for non-profit use.
terms.where: opening post; also in the Sun/Moon and Gen 8 opening posts

terms.text: You are free to use this in any project that is not a for-profit product. You must make a credit page and link back to this thread. If you are only using a few sprites we appreciate you crediting the individual spriters. Please do not redistribute these sprites as it gives the false impression you created all of them. These sprites are not open source, because we do not have the rights to the characters depicted.

For use of the project on the whole do take the time to contact Layell, it's a public project but we like to know where and how they are being used. Layell might also help send updates easily if need be. We do require the site and project to have a credits page to link back to this thread.
terms.where: opening post, FAQ 'Can I use these sprites for my website/fangame/project?'

terms.text: If you want to use a specific spriters stuff ask them on Smogon, Deviantart, or PS. Many of the spriters will say yes, some of the Deviantart ones will say you can with credit right on their page. But take the time to find out, and link to them and the XY project if it was a collaboration between many spriters of the project.
The license for these community-created sprites is still being determined and may change in the future, but in the meantime please talk to use first before using them.
